description: Solana validator and host health dashboard maintained by Stakeconomy.com. Links each validator identity to its reporting system host and supports dynamic mounts, interfaces, and aligned software/status timelines.

options.content:
# Stakeconomy Community Monitoring Dashboard
Choose a **Validator identity** for Solana metrics and a **System host** for operating-system metrics. These selectors are independent so the dashboard also supports system-only hosts. Mount-point and network-interface selectors adapt to each host.

*Provided by [Stakeconomy.com](https://stakeconomy.com) · [Monitoring repository](https://github.com/stakeconomy/solanamonitoring)*

panels.description: Active stake on the validator.
panels.title: Active Stake
Community validators online
panels.description: Validators that sent a status sample during the last 10 minutes.

panels.title: Selected disk max
panels.description: Highest utilization among the selected data mount points. Runtime, package, container, hidden and virtual filesystems are excluded.

panels.title: Host disk max
panels.description: Highest utilization across relevant data filesystems. /var/lib, boot, runtime, package, container, hidden and virtual mounts are excluded.

panels.title: 5m load / CPU
panels.description: Five-minute load average normalized by logical CPU count, so differently sized hosts are comparable.

panels.title: Software version
panels.description: Numeric version code reported by the monitor. The timeline below makes upgrades visible against performance.
Current identity-account balance. Red below 1 SOL, yellow below 5 SOL.
panels.title: Identity balance

panels.description: Current vote-account balance.
panels.title: Vote-account balance

panels.description: Current percentage of activated cluster stake on delinquent vote accounts.
panels.title: Cluster delinquent stake

panels.description: Validator skip rate minus cluster skip rate, in percentage points.
panels.title: Skip-rate gap
My Skiprate
panels.description: Validator and cluster skip rates. Software changes are shown separately in the aligned timeline below.

panels.title: Cluster TPS
panels.description: Five-minute rate of the cluster transaction counter.
Software version state aligned with the skip-rate chart above. A color boundary marks an upgrade without overlaying another line on performance data.
panels.title: Validator software version

panels.description: Validating, delinquent and monitor-error periods aligned with cluster TPS above.
panels.title: Validator health state
My Credits
panels.description: Five-minute rate of earned vote credits.

panels.title: Vote-credit efficiency
panels.description: Earned timely vote credits as a percentage of the theoretical maximum.

panels.title: Cluster delinquent stake
panels.description: Percentage of total activated cluster stake currently assigned to delinquent vote accounts.
SOL held by the selected validator identity account.
panels.title: Identity-account balance

panels.description: Active stake on the validator.
panels.title: Active Stake

panels.description: SOL held by the selected validator vote account.
panels.title: Vote-account balance
CPU usage
panels.description: CPU time by the five categories that matter operationally. Per-core collection is intentionally disabled in the optimized Telegraf profile.

panels.title: Filesystem utilization — $mountpoint
panels.description: Utilization for selected data mount points. /var/lib, boot, runtime, package, container, hidden and virtual filesystems are excluded.

panels.title: Load per CPU capacity
panels.description: Load averages normalized by logical CPU count; 100% means one runnable task per logical CPU.

panels.title: Memory usage
panels.description: Host memory totals without redundant aggregation over a single selected host.

panels.title: Network traffic — receive ↑ / transmit ↓ — $interface
panels.description: Mirrored traffic view: receive is shown above zero and transmit below zero. The negative transmit direction is a display transform only; stored values, legend statistics and tooltips remain positive.

panels.title: System allocated file handles
panels.description: System-wide allocated file handles reported by the validator monitor; unavailable on system-only Telegraf hosts.

targets.query: SELECT non_negative_derivative(mean(udp_indatagrams), 1s) as "in datagrams" FROM "net" WHERE host =~ /$server/ AND $timeFilter GROUP BY time($interval), * fill(none)
SELECT non_negative_derivative(mean(udp_outdatagrams), 1s) as "out datagrams" FROM "net" WHERE host =~ /$server/ AND $timeFilter GROUP BY time($interval), * fill(none)

panels.title: Processes
panels.description: The four process states most useful for validator troubleshooting.

panels.title: TCP connections
panels.description: Useful TCP socket states; transitional noise is omitted.

panels.title: IOWait
panels.description: Ten-minute mean CPU time spent waiting for I/O.

panels.title: Network errors and drops
panels.description: Per-second interface errors/drops plus UDP checksum, socket-buffer and no-listener errors.

targets.query: SELECT non_negative_derivative(mean(context_switches),1s)as "context switches"  FROM "kernel" WHERE host =~ /$server$/ AND $timeFilter GROUP BY time($interval), host ORDER BY asc
